title: P1-C paired data: timing-preserving mechanical rendering with explicit blockers
hypothesis: Rendering each syllable at the onset measured from the real utterance keeps the mechanical and real signals the same length and keeps pauses; syllables whose onset/coda the backend cannot speak are reported as blocked rather than approximated.

git.status: dirty (src/vhe/data/pairing.py, tests/test_data_pairing.py, experiments/EXP-0006 uncommitted during the run)

gpu: Apple M5 (MPS available, unused in this experiment)
notes: Synthetic fixtures only: the 'real' signal is rendered by the same formant backend, so this experiment proves plumbing and timing alignment, not real-speech alignment or naturalness. No AISHELL-3 corpus on this machine; AISHELL-3 syllables with onsets are structurally blocked because the backend inventory is {a,i,u}. Record created after the implementation (process deviation, same as EXP-0003/0004).
